title: Correct final speed
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (1) must be v = sqrt(2gh).

title: Correct average power
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (2) must be P_avg = mgh / t_0.

title: Apply work-energy theorem
description: Important: The solution for part (1) must correctly apply the work-energy theorem or conservation of mechanical energy, equating mgh to (1/2)mv^2.

title: Define average power
description: Important: The solution for part (2) must correctly define average power as the total work done by gravity (mgh) divided by the elapsed time (t_0).

title: Consistent use of symbols
description: Optional: The solution uses the given symbols (m, g, h, t_0) consistently and does not introduce unnecessary variables.

title: Unit analysis or mention
description: Optional: The solution includes or implies correct units for speed (m/s) and power (W).

title: Incorrect energy principle
description: Pitfall: Using kinematics (e.g., v = gt) instead of energy conservation to find the speed at O, which is incorrect as the path is not vertical free fall.

title: Misidentifying work or time
description: Pitfall: For part (2), using an incorrect expression for the work done by gravity (not mgh) or using a calculated time instead of the given t_0.
